responsibility: This file is GCC’s specialized VxWorks wrapper for <setjmp.h>, distinct from the generic _yvals-wrapper path because the underlying header must still perceive a C++ compilation to provide the proper namespaces. It explicitly pre-includes GCC’s _yvals.h shim, then includes the next system setjmp.h unchanged with __cplusplus still defined, relying on setjmp.h’s own VxWorks-specific handling while still ensuring the needed yvals configuration is present first.
